title: 2026 Glomerulopathies with Organized Deposits  病理分型、EM 結構微觀、DNAJB9 與臨床實戰

sections.title: Section 1: Overview & Classification Framework of Organized Glomerular Deposits
sections.content:
### Topology Mapping Matrix
* **Structural Classification of Glomerular Deposits**:
  - **Non-Organized (Amorphous) Immune Complex Deposits**: 最常見，如 Lupus Nephritis (Class III/IV), Membranous Nephropathy, IgA Nephropathy, MPGN Type I/III。於 Electron Microscopy (EM) 下呈結構極為均勻無特定走向之 Electron-Dense Material。
  - **Organized Deposits (Fibrillar & Microtubular)**: 具高度幾何組織與週期性重覆排列結構，可依據 Substructure, Diameter, Congo Red Affinity, and Immunoglobulin Monoclonality 進行精準分類。
* **Organized Deposit Classification Taxonomy**:
  1. **Congo Red Positive Fibrillar Deposits (8-12 nm)**: **Amyloidosis** (AL, AA, ALECT2, ATTR, ApoA1)。
  2. **Congo Red Negative Fibrillar Deposits (16-24 nm)**: **Fibrillary Glomerulonephritis (FGN)** (DNAJB9 Positive, Polyclonal IgG/C3 > Monoclonal)。
  3. **Microtubular Hollow Stacks (30-50 nm)**: **Immunotactoid Glomerulopathy (ITG)** (High Association with Monoclonal Gammopathy & Lymphoproliferative Disorders)。
  4. **Annular-Tubular Curvilinear Arrays (30 nm)**: **Cryoglobulinemic Glomerulonephritis** (Type I / Type II Mixed Cryoglobulinemia, HCV-associated)。
  5. **Fingerprint Microtubular Arrays (10-15 nm)**: **Lupus Nephritis** (Subendothelial & Mesangial Fingerprint Deposits)。
  6. **Collagenous Fibrils (40-70 nm with 60 nm Banding)**: **Collagenofibrotic Glomerulopathy** (Type III Collagen) & **Nail-Patella Syndrome**.
  7. **Non-Fibrillar Amorphous / Granular Matrix Expansion**: **Fibronectin Glomerulopathy** (*FN1* Mutation).

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Disease Entity | Fibril / Tubule Diameter | Substructure under EM | Congo Red Staining | Diagnostic IHC / Biomarker | Primary Association |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Amyloidosis** | 8-12 nm | Solid, randomly arranged non-branching microfibrils | Positive (Apple-green birefringence) | SAP, SAA, Lambda/Kappa | Plasma Cell Dyscrasia / Chronic Inflammation |
| **Fibrillary GN (FGN)** | 16-24 nm | Solid, randomly oriented non-branching fibrils | Negative (or weak/faint positive) | **DNAJB9 Positive** (Sensitivity > 98%) | Polyclonal IgG, Malignancy, Autoimmune |
| **Immunotactoid Glomerulopathy (ITG)** | 30-50 nm | Hollow, organized parallel microtubular stacks | Negative | Monoclonal Ig restriction (Kappa/Lambda) | Monoclonal Gammopathy / CLL / Lymphoma |
| **Cryoglobulinemic GN** | 30 nm | Curvilinear, annular-tubular, fingerprint-like | Negative | IgM / IgG with RF activity | HCV Infection, Lymphoma, Essential Cryo |
| **Collagenofibrotic Glomerulopathy** | 40-70 nm | Curved, frayed fibrils with 60 nm periodic cross-banding | Negative | Type III Collagen | Autosomal Recessive / Systemic Collagen III excess |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
```
[Glomerular Biopsy Showing Electron-Dense Deposits on EM]
       │
       ├─► Is Deposit Structure Organized (Fibrillar / Microtubular)?
       │     │
       │     ├─► Congo Red Positive ──► 8-12 nm Fibrils ──► Renal Amyloidosis (AL / AA)
       │     │
       │     └─► Congo Red Negative
       │           ├─► Fibrillar (Solid, Random) ──► 16-24 nm + DNAJB9 (+) ──► Fibrillary GN (FGN)
       │           ├─► Microtubular (Hollow, Stacks) ──► 30-50 nm ──► Immunotactoid Glomerulopathy (ITG)
       │           ├─► Annular-Tubular Curvilinear ──► 30 nm + Intraluminal Thrombi ──► Cryoglobulinemic GN
       │           └─► Banded Collagen Fibrils ──► 40-70 nm + 60 nm Banding ──► Collagenofibrotic Glomerulopathy
       │
       └─► Non-Organized Amorphous Deposits ──► Immune Complex GN (LN, MN, IgAN, MPGN)
```

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
1. **Fibril Diameter Measurement Trap**: 於 Electron Microscopy 判讀時，**Diameter 是金標準鑑別指標**：Amyloidosis 為 8-12 nm；Fibrillary GN 為 16-24 nm (約為 Amyloid 的兩倍大)；Immunotactoid GN 為 30-50 nm (且中間呈現 Hollow Lumen)。
2. **Congo Red False Positivity Trap**: Fibrillary GN 偶爾在極少數切片呈現微弱或 Faint Congo Red Staining，但絕無經典 Apple-Green Birefringence，且 DNAJB9 IHC Positive 即可精確與 Amyloidosis 隔絕。

sections.title: Section 2: Amyloidosis (AL & AA Amyloidosis): Pathogenesis, Staining & Spicular Spikes
sections.content:
### Topology Mapping Matrix
* **Pathophysiology of Renal Amyloidosis**:
  - **AL Amyloidosis (Primary Amyloidosis)**: 由 Plasma Cell Dyscrasia 或 Multiple Myeloma 產生之 Monoclonal Free Light Chains (Lambda 佔 75%, Kappa 佔 25%) 經 Proteolytic Cleavage Misfolding 形成 Cross-Beta-Pleated Sheet Structural Microfibrils。
  - **AA Amyloidosis (Secondary Amyloidosis)**: 由 Chronic Inflammatory States (Rheumatoid Arthritis, Ankylosing Spondylitis, Inflammatory Bowel Disease, Familial Mediterranean Fever) 致使 Acute-Phase Reactant **Serum Amyloid A (SAA)** 在 Liver 過度合成並沉積於 Target Organs。
* **Histopathological Triad**:
  - **Light Microscopy (LM)**: Mesangial Expansion by Amorphous, Acellular, Eosinophilic Material。PAS Stain 呈現 Weakly Positive (與 Kimmelstiel-Wilson Nodules 的 Intensely PAS Positive 不同)。Jones Methenamine Silver Stain 展現經典 **Spicular Hair-like / Comb-like Spikes** (Amyloid Fibrils 穿破 GBM 向上皮側延伸)。
  - **Polarized Microscopy**: **Congo Red Stain** 於 Polarized Light 下展現 Pathognomonic **Apple-Green Birefringence**。
  - **Electron Microscopy (EM)**: **8-12 nm Non-branching, Haphazardly Arranged Microfibrils** 充斥於 Mesangium, Subendothelium, and GBM Thickness。

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Amyloid Subtype | Precursor Protein | Light Chain Predominance | Staining & Diagnostics | Primary Clinical Associations |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AL Amyloidosis** | Immunoglobulin Light Chain | **Lambda (λ) > Kappa (κ)** (3:1 ratio) | IHC for Lambda/Kappa; Congo Red Apple-Green (+) | Plasma Cell Dyscrasia, Multiple Myeloma, MGUS |
| **AA Amyloidosis** | Serum Amyloid A (SAA) | None (Non-immunoglobulin SAA precursor) | IHC for SAA; Potassium Permanganate Pretreatment abolishes Congo Red | Rheumatoid Arthritis, FMF, Bronchiectasis, Osteomyelitis |
| **ALECT2 Amyloidosis** | Leukocyte Cell-Derived Chemotaxin 2 | None | IHC for ALECT2; Hepatic + Renal involvement | Hispanic / Mexican-American Predominance |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
```
[Plasma Cell Dyscrasia (AL) OR Chronic Inflammation (AA)]
       │
       ▼
[Overproduction of Unfolded Precursor Proteins (Light Chain / SAA)]
       │
       ▼
[Aggregation into Beta-Pleated Sheet Amyloid Fibrils (8-12 nm)]
       │
       ▼
[Glomerular Mesangial & Vascular Deposition]
       │
       ├─► Silver Stain: Spicular Spikes (Comb-like Projections)
       ├─► Congo Red: Apple-Green Birefringence under Polarized Light
       └─► Massive Non-Selective Proteinuria ──► Nephrotic Syndrome ──► Progressive Renal Failure
```

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
1. **Light Chain Ratio Trap**: 於 Light Chain Deposition Disease (LCDD) 中，Kappa (κ) Light Chain 佔絕大多數 (> 80%)；然而於 AL Amyloidosis 中，**Lambda (λ) Light Chain 才是主要病因 (> 75%)**。
2. **Silver Stain vs PAS Stain Trap**: Amyloid Deposits 於 PAS Stain 呈 Weakly Positive，於 Silver Stain 呈 Negative 至 Faint Blue/Gray，但 Amyloid 突破 GBM 外側會形成 Silver-Staining Spikes (Spicular Spikes)，不可誤診為 Membranous Nephropathy 的 Subepithelial Spikes。

sections.title: Section 3: Fibrillary Glomerulonephritis (FGN) vs Immunotactoid Glomerulopathy (ITG)
sections.content:
### Topology Mapping Matrix
* **Fibrillary Glomerulonephritis (FGN)**:
  - **Biomarker Discovery**: **DNAJB9 (Heat Shock Protein Co-chaperone)** 為 FGN 的 Specific & Sensitive Biomarker。Glomerular DNAJB9 IHC Staining 具 > 98% Sensitivity 與 99% Specificity。
  - **Ultrastructure (EM)**: **16-24 nm Solid, Randomly Oriented Non-branching Fibrils** 沉積於 Mesangium 與 Subendothelium。大小約為 Amyloid (8-12 nm) 的兩倍大。
  - **Immunofluorescence**: **Polyclonal IgG (IgG4 Predominance) & C3**。僅少數病例 (< 15%) 伴隨 Monoclonal Light Chain Restriction。
* **Immunotactoid Glomerulopathy (ITG)**:
  - **Ultrastructure (EM)**: **30-50 nm Hollow Microtubules Arranged in Parallel Stacks or Bundles** (比 FGN 更大且中間有 Hollow Center)。
  - **Immunofluorescence & Pathology**: 幾乎 100% 呈現 **Monoclonal Immunoglobulin Restriction** (IgG Kappa or IgG Lambda)。
  - **Hematologic Coupling**: 極度高度強烈關聯 **CLL (Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia), Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma, and Monoclonal Gammopathy of Renal Significance (MGRS)**。

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Feature | Fibrillary Glomerulonephritis (FGN) | Immunotactoid Glomerulopathy (ITG) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Deposit Substructure** | Solid, randomly oriented non-branching fibrils | Hollow microtubules in parallel stacks/bundles |
| **Deposit Diameter** | **16-24 nm** | **30-50 nm** |
| **DNAJB9 IHC Staining** | **Intensely Positive** in > 98% of cases | **Negative** |
| **Immunoglobulin Clonality** | Predominantly **Polyclonal IgG** (IgG4 & IgG1) | Predominantly **Monoclonal Ig** (MGRS pattern) |
| **Associated Malignancy** | Solid tumors, HCV, Autoimmune disease (SLE) | Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia (CLL), B-cell Lymphoma |
| **Renal Prognosis** | Poor (ESKD in 50% within 2-4 years) | Dependent on underlying Lymphoproliferative Disease treatment |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
```
[Renal Biopsy Showing Congo Red Negative Fibrillar / Microtubular Deposits]
       │
       ├─► Perform DNAJB9 Immunohistochemistry (IHC)
       │     │
       │     ├─► DNAJB9 Positive ──► Measure Fibril Diameter (16-24 nm, Solid)
       │     │     │
       │     │     └─► Diagnosis: Fibrillary Glomerulonephritis (FGN)
       │     │           └─► Polyclonal IgG4/C3 Deposits; Evaluate for Solid Tumor / Autoimmune
       │     │
       │     └─► DNAJB9 Negative ──► Evaluate Microtubule Substructure (30-50 nm, Hollow Stacks)
       │           │
       │           └─► Diagnosis: Immunotactoid Glomerulopathy (ITG)
       │                 └─► Monoclonal Ig Restriction; Mandatory Hematologic Workup (CLL / Lymphoma)
```

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
1. **DNAJB9 Specificity Trap**: DNAJB9 只對 Fibrillary Glomerulonephritis (FGN) 呈 Positive；Amyloidosis, ITG, Lupus Nephritis, Cryoglobulinemic GN, Diabetic Nephropathy 一律呈 Negative。
2. **Clonality Misconception Trap**: 無法僅用 Fibril 存在與否定義 MGRS！FGN 大多為 Polyclonal，而 ITG 才是核心由 Monoclonal B-cell / Plasma Cell Clone 所驅動之 MGRS 病理表現。

sections.title: Section 4: Cryoglobulinemic Glomerulonephritis & Lupus Fingerprint Deposits
sections.content:
### Topology Mapping Matrix
* **Cryoglobulinemic Glomerulonephritis**:
  - **Cryoglobulin Subtypes**:
    - **Type I Cryoglobulinemia**: Monoclonal Ig (IgM or IgG), 關聯 Multiple Myeloma / Waldenström Macroglobulinemia。
    - **Type II Cryoglobulinemia**: Mixed (Monoclonal IgM with Rheumatoid Factor activity binding Polyclonal IgG), 最強大關聯 **Hepatitis C Virus (HCV)**。
    - **Type III Cryoglobulinemia**: Polyclonal IgM with RF activity binding Polyclonal IgG, 關聯 Autoimmune Diseases (SLE, Sjögren).
  - **Histopathology**: Classic **MPGN (Membranous-Proliferative GN) Pattern** 伴隨 Endocapillary Proliferation, Neutrophil Infiltration, and Double Contours (Tram-tracks)。PAS Stain 可見大量填滿血管腔之 **Intraluminal PAS-Positive Hyaline Pseudothrombi**。
  - **Ultrastructure (EM)**: **30 nm Annular-Tubular / Curvilinear Substructure**。
* **Lupus Nephritis Fingerprint Deposits**:
  - **Substructure under EM**: 大量 Subendothelial Wire-Loop Immune Deposits 中，有時呈現局部 10-15 nm Curvilinear Parallel Arrays，被稱為 **Fingerprint Pattern**。高度指示 Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (Class III / Class IV LN)。

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Disease Entity | Ultrastructure Morphology | Tubule / Fibril Diameter | Typical Light Microscopy | Classic Serologic Association |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Cryoglobulinemic GN** | Annular-tubular curvilinear structures | **30 nm** | MPGN pattern + Intraluminal PAS-positive pseudothrombi | Positive HCV RNA, Low C4, Positive RF, Cryocrit (+) |
| **Lupus Fingerprint Deposits** | Concentric, parallel fingerprint-like arrays | **10-15 nm** | Class III/IV LN (Wire-loop deposits, Crescents) | Positive ANA, Anti-dsDNA, Low C3 & C4, Full-House IF |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
```
[Renal Biopsy with Endocapillary Proliferation & Subendothelial Deposits]
       │
       ├─► Intraluminal PAS-Positive Thrombi & Curvilinear 30 nm Substructure
       │     │
       │     └─► Diagnosis: Cryoglobulinemic Glomerulonephritis
       │           ├─► Check Serum Cryocrit & Rheumatoid Factor (RF)
       │           └─► Test for Hepatitis C Virus (HCV RNA) & Lymphoma
       │
       └─► "Full-House" IF (IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q) & 10-15 nm Fingerprint Array
             │
             └─► Diagnosis: Lupus Nephritis (Class III / IV with Fingerprint Pattern)
```

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
1. **Hypocomplementemia Pattern Trap**: Cryoglobulinemia 的 Complement Profile 特色為 **Disproportionately Low C4 with Normal/Mildly Reduced C3** (因為 Classical Pathway 被 Monoclonal IgM RF 大量活化)；而 Active Lupus Nephritis 通常為 C3 與 C4 同時大幅下降。
2. **Cold Transport Requirement**: 採驗 Serum Cryoglobulin 時，血液檢體必須保溫於 **37°C 溫水中運送至實驗室**，否則 Cryoglobulins 會在室溫下提早沉澱，造成偽陰性報告！

sections.title: Section 5: Rare Organized Deposit Glomerulopathies: Collagenofibrotic & Fibronectin Glomerulopathy
sections.content:
### Topology Mapping Matrix
* **Collagenofibrotic Glomerulopathy (Collagen Type III Glomerulopathy)**:
  - **Pathophysiology**: 全身性 Type III Collagen 代謝或合成異常，致使大量 Type III Collagen 異常沉積於 Glomerular Mesangium 及 Subendothelial Space。
  - **Histopathology**: Marked Mesangial Expansion & Nodular Glomerulosclerosis。PAS Staining 呈 Weakly Positive，Masson Trichrome Staining 呈 **Intensely Blue** (代表 Collagen Rich)。
  - **Ultrastructure (EM)**: **40-70 nm Curved, Frayed Collagen Fibrils with Characteristic 60 nm Periodic Cross-Banding** 充斥於 Mesangium。
  - **Lab Marker**: High Serum Levels of **Procollagen Type III N-terminal Peptide (PIIINP)**。
* **Fibronectin Glomerulopathy**:
  - **Genetics & Pathophysiology**: **Autosomal Dominant** 遺傳，由 **FN1 Gene Mutation** (Encoding Fibronectin 1) 導致異常 Fibronectin 蛋白質沉積。
  - **Histopathology**: Massive Silver-Negative, PAS-Positive Mesangial Expansion。
  - **Ultrastructure (EM)**: Mesangium 充斥非纖維狀之 **Finely Granular-Fibrillar Electron-Dense Material** (DNAJB9 & Congo Red 皆 Negative)。

### High-Yield Differential Comparison Table
| Rare Entity | Primary Deposited Substance | Fibril Banding / Diameter | Masson Trichrome Staining | Genetic / Serum Biomarker |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Collagenofibrotic Glomerulopathy** | Type III Collagen | 40-70 nm with **60 nm periodic banding** | **Intensely Blue** | Elevated Serum PIIINP |
| **Fibronectin Glomerulopathy** | Fibronectin (FN1) | Non-fibrillar granular-fibrillar material | Weak Blue / Red | *FN1* Gene Mutation (Autosomal Dominant) |
| **Nail-Patella Syndrome** | Type III Collagen in GBM | Banded collagen fibrils within rarefied GBM lucencies | Variable | *LMX1B* Mutation (Nail dysplasia, absent patella) |

### Pathophysiological Decision Tree
```
[Nodular Glomerulosclerosis Negative for Amyloid & Monoclonal Light Chains]
       │
       ├─► Masson Trichrome Intensely Blue & EM Shows 40-70 nm Fibrils with 60 nm Banding
       │     │
       │     └─► Diagnosis: Collagenofibrotic Glomerulopathy (Elevated Serum PIIINP)
       │
       └─► Massive Silver-Negative Mesangial Expansion & Family History of AD Proteinuria
             │
             └─► Diagnosis: Fibronectin Glomerulopathy (Confirm FN1 Gene Mutation)
```

### Conceptual Trap Analysis
1. **Collagen Periodic Banding Trap**: Collagenofibrotic Glomerulopathy 在 EM 下的特徵為 **60 nm (或 65 nm) Periodic Cross-Banding**，此結構於 Amyloidosis (8-12 nm)、FGN (16-24 nm) 或 ITG (30-50 nm) 絕對看不到。
2. **Diabetic Nodular Sclerosis Differential Trap**: 當切片看到 Nodular Glomerulosclerosis 但患者沒有 Diabetes Mellitus 時，必須列出五大鑑別診斷：(1) Amyloidosis, (2) MIDD / LCDD, (3) FGN / ITG, (4) Collagenofibrotic Glomerulopathy, (5) Fibronectin Glomerulopathy。
